desc: Paper Mario 64 enemies in the story (hei_01, all PM64): Goombella Tattles every enemy of two of Petal Meadows's field enemies' battles (`battle`: the nearest enemy NPC, as a story fight is armed only for a field enemy since the townsfolk fix; `battle N` handed the fight to Koops); each Tattle card's picture is the PM64 enemy's sprite from the ROM (its idle), not its TTYD host's model, captured ($TTYD_TATTLE_SHOT) and checked neither empty nor garbage (tattle_check)
log_must: \[pm64\] tattle card: kind \d+ drawn as sprite \d+ row \d+ \((?!a boss)
